input: Sort through and donate old kids' clothing by size

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which clothing is included (all kids' clothes, specific seasons, specific children) determines the volume and complexity of the sort.
Whether this is for one child or multiple children affects how sorting is structured and what gets kept vs. donated.
Where the clothes are stored right now (multiple rooms, one closet, bins in storage) affects how to approach the physical gathering step.
A deadline (e.g., a donation drive, a new baby arriving, a move) changes how urgently and thoroughly this needs to happen.
Which donation destination is preferred (specific charity, consignment, a friend/family member) affects drop-off steps and any preparation needed like bagging or tagging.
The keep/donate decision rule (e.g., saving sizes for a future sibling vs. donating everything outgrown) changes how much stays and how much goes.
Knowing what 'done' looks like — fully sorted and dropped off, or just bagged and ready — sets the finish line for the task.

gold.taskTitle: Sort and donate old kids' clothing by size
gold.taskDescription: Go through children's clothing, organize it by size, and donate what is no longer needed.

questions.title: Which children's clothing is included in this sort?
questions.description: Clarify whether all kids' clothing is in scope or just specific categories like a certain season, type (outerwear, everyday), or belonging to one child.

questions.title: How many children's wardrobes are you sorting through?
questions.description: Determine if this involves one child or multiple children, which affects how the sorting is organized.

questions.title: Where is the clothing stored right now?
questions.description: Find out if clothes are in one place or spread across closets, bins, attic, or storage unit so gathering can be planned.

questions.title: Is there a deadline driving this project?
questions.description: Identify any time pressure such as a donation drive, a new baby coming, or an upcoming move.

questions.title: Where do you plan to donate the clothing?
questions.description: Determine the intended recipient — a specific charity, consignment shop, or a friend or family member — to plan prep and drop-off steps.

questions.title: Are you saving any sizes for a younger sibling later?
questions.description: Understand the keep-vs-donate rule, since saving sizes for future use changes how much gets set aside versus donated.

questions.title: What does fully done look like for this task?
questions.description: Clarify the finish line — whether it means clothes are sorted and bagged, or fully delivered to the donation destination.
